payload.value:
FR-142 made the server emit object deletes over the sync gateway as a Delta frame carrying BOTH a back-compat tombstone object record (the current Swift/Android SDKs refetch on any object delta and drop the now-absent row) AND a new optional `removed: { type, id }[]` list on DeltaPayload.

This story: have the Swift (FrickSyncSocket) and Kotlin SDKs consume `removed` directly — drop those (type,id) rows from the local cache and surface them to observers — instead of triggering a full refetch on the tombstone. Cheaper (no round-trip), and correct even when the deleted type isn't otherwise being refetched.

- Decode the optional `removed` field from the Delta payload in each SDK's frame decoder.
- Apply removals to the local object store + emit an objectsDelta/observation so SwiftUI/Compose drop the row.
- Keep the tombstone-refetch path as fallback for servers that predate FR-142.
- Tests per platform: subscribe, receive a Delta with `removed`, assert the row is dropped without a network refetch.
